name: Plancks
author: gregl83
description: A second clock, tuned to your daily rhythm. An Omarchy productivity widget with a Pomodoro timer, custom session timers for focus, study, exercise, and rest, and local time tracking. Track daily epochs and off-time with learned predictions, countdowns, notifications, searchable history, and trend charts. Animated Sun and moon, Coffee cup, SpaceX-inspired Starship, and Tesla-inspired Roadster graphics bring your timer to life. No account or cloud service.
